description: Transforms pitch AND rhythm of the grains in one pass: a text data file of transposition/time-multiplier PAIRS (transpmultfile) is applied cyclically - grain k gets pair k's semitone shift while the k-th onset-to-onset time is multiplied by pair k's multiplier (submode 1 pinned: each grain once, list cycles; submode 2 plays each grain in EVERY listed way first - verified 4.9921 s from 2.0 s with a 2-pair file). This is grain repitch + grain rerhythm fused, sharing their conventions exactly. Verified: '12 0.5 / -12 2.0' on a 0.2 s-grid 2.0 s train -> 2.4923 s (gaps alternate x0.5/x2.0, matching rerhythm's arithmetic: 9 gaps -> 5x0.1 + 4x0.4 + un-retimed head/tail). Pair ranges CDP-enforced with dash-form INVALID DATA refusals: transpositions +-48 semitones ('Pitch-ratio (50.000000) out of range (-48.000000 - 48.000000)'), multipliers 0.001-1000 ('Time-ratio (2000.000000) out of range (0.001000 - 1000.000000)'); unpaired values refuse 'Pitch and time ratios not paired correctly.' The static duration model is the mean-multiplier==1 baseline (see known_issues). Standard family gate (default 0.3, byte-verified). Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Full motif transformation of found events - each grain becomes a note with its own pitch and its own duration slot. '12 0.5 / -12 2.0' makes a high-short/low-long lilt out of an even pulse; '0 1 / 4 0.5 / 7 0.25' writes an accelerating arpeggio into the grain stream; keeping all multipliers at 1 reduces it to grain repitch, all transpositions at 0 to grain rerhythm - so prototype the two dimensions separately, then fuse. Because the pair list cycles, pattern-length vs grain-count mismatches produce evolving (phasing) variations instead of loops. Duration scales by roughly the mean multiplier; grains keep their internal speed, so shrunken gaps make events overlap-tight while every attack stays crisp. Gate craft as ever: run grain find first (see grain_find).

transpmultfile.description: Auxiliary text data file of PAIRS 'semitones multiplier' (one pair per line or space-separated; write with write_data_file(), any extension except .brk). Applied cyclically. CDP-enforced per value: transposition +-48 st, multiplier 0.001-1000 (dash-form refusals quoted in description); odd value counts refuse 'ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: Pitch and time ratios not paired correctly.' Intergrain times shrunk below MINGRAINTIME (0.032 s) are clamped to 0.032.

len.description: Maximum time between grains in seconds (family-standard: CDP-enforced 0.1 to the input duration). Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

gate.description: Required signal level for a grain to be seen (CDP-enforced 0-1; real default 0.3, family-wide). Breakpoint-CAPABLE (verified: a 0.05->0.5 gate ramp render differs from both scalar-endpoint renders on an alternating loud/soft train).

minhole.description: Minimum duration of inter-grain holes (CDP-enforced 0.032 - the default - to the input duration, family-standard). Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

winsize.description: Envelope-tracking window in ms for a signal-tracking gate; 0 = off (family-standard). Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

ignore_last.description: Ignore the last grain in the source. Must follow the value flags (family-wide flag-order enforcement).

examples.description: High-short / low-long lilt from an even pulse.
examples.expected_use: Alternating +12st-at-half-time and -12st-at-double-time events (first write_data_file('lilt.txt', '12 0.5\n-12 2.0')); duration ~x1.25 on an even grid.

examples.description: Accelerating arpeggio cell written into a grain stream.
examples.expected_use: Cycling 0/+4/+7 semitones at multipliers 1/0.5/0.25 - motif compresses each cycle (write_data_file('arp.txt', '0 1\n4 0.5\n7 0.25')).

known_issues: Duration honesty (static model): actual duration = sum(cycled multiplier_i x intergrain_i) + un-retimed head/tail (rerhythm's verified arithmetic; '12 0.5 / -12 2.0' -> 2.4923 s from 2.0 s, +25% vs the static baseline). The static model is only the mean-multiplier==1 baseline - scale expectations by the mean multiplier; sub-0.032 s gaps clamp to 0.032.
Submode pinned to 1. Submode 2 plays each grain at EVERY pair before advancing - duration multiplies by the pair count on top of the multiplier effect (verified 4.9921 s from 2.0 s, 2 pairs).
Range errors are INVALID DATA refusals in the dash form, labelled 'Pitch-ratio' / 'Time-ratio'; unpaired data refuses 'Pitch and time ratios not paired correctly.'
TRAP (family-wide): a time/value breakpoint file in the transpmultfile slot is read as a flat value list - its times become 'transpositions' and its values 'multipliers'.
Acceptance-with-truncation landmine (family-wide): verify segmentation with grain find before trusting the pairing - a missed grain boundary shifts every subsequent pair assignment.
DIVERGENCE: banner gate 'default 1' vs real default 0.3; manual len minimum '1' vs enforced 0.1 (family-wide).
Deterministic (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical). Stereo accepted (verified 2-channel).
